question: In which traditional Indian game do players hold their breath and say a specific word repeatedly while trying to tag opponents? 🏃
explanation: Super! In Kabaddi, a raider goes into the other team's side and constantly chants 'Kabaddi, Kabaddi' without taking a breath! 🤼
hint: The name of the game is what they chant.

question: What word do players shout to pass their turn to a sitting teammate in Kho-Kho? 🗣️
explanation: Awesome! In Kho-Kho, you touch your teammate's back and loudly say 'Kho' to let them run! 🏃
hint: It is the name of the game!

question: Which game uses exactly seven flat stones stacked on top of each other? 🪨
explanation: Great job! Pitthu is a very fun game where we stack seven flat stones to make a little tower. 🪨
hint: It is also known as Seven Stones.

question: What object is used to hit and break the stack of stones in Pitthu? 🎾
explanation: Super! We use a soft ball to carefully hit and break the tower of stones in Pitthu! 🎾

question: In which fun game do you hop on only one leg to catch your friends? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! Langdi is a great balancing game where you hop on one leg and try to tag others! 🦵
hint: You have to balance on one foot.

question: What equipment do two teams pull in the game of Tug of War? 🪢
explanation: Great job! In Tug of War (Rassa Kashi), both teams pull a long, strong rope to win! 🪢
hint: It is long, thick, and made of threads.

question: How do players sit while waiting for their turn in Kho-Kho? 🧘
explanation: Super! Kho-Kho players sit in a straight line, facing opposite directions so they can watch everywhere! 👀

question: Which game is played using two wooden sticks of different sizes? 🪵
explanation: Awesome! Gilli Danda uses a long stick (Danda) to hit a small oval stick (Gilli) really far! 🪵
hint: The name has the two tools in it.

question: In which game does one person close their eyes and count while others hide? 🙈
explanation: Great job! Hide and Seek (Chhupan Chhupai) is a super fun game of hiding and finding friends! 🙈
hint: You have to stay very quiet so you are not found!

question: What do two players make with their hands in the singing game Poshampa? 🌉
explanation: Super! In Poshampa, two players hold hands high to make a bridge for others to pass under! 🌉
hint: You walk under it like a tunnel.

question: What do we need most to play traditional team games like Kabaddi? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! Games like Kabaddi need all players to work together as a strong team! 🤝

question: Who goes to the other team's side to tag players in Kabaddi? 🏃
explanation: Great job! The Raider is the brave player who goes into the other half to tag opponents! 🏃
hint: They run into the opponent's area.

question: What happens when a raider touches you and crosses the line in Kabaddi? 👋
explanation: Super! If a raider safely tags you, you have to sit out until your team brings you back! 🪑
hint: You step outside the court for a while.

question: What part of the body do you gently touch to give a 'Kho'? ✋
explanation: Awesome! You gently touch your teammate's back and say 'Kho' to pass the turn! ✋

question: What must a raider touch to come back safely in Kabaddi? ➖
explanation: Great job! A raider must touch the midline to safely return to their own side and win points! ➖
hint: It divides the court into two halves.

question: In Pitthu, what does the hitting team try to do after the stones fall? 🧱
explanation: Super! The hitting team quickly tries to stack the seven stones back up before getting hit by the ball! 🧱

question: What is the best way to treat your friends while playing together? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! Playing with kindness and respect makes the game fun for everyone! 🤝

question: What does it mean to play a game fairly? ⚖️
explanation: Great job! Fair play means following the rules honestly and being a good sport! ⚖️

question: How many stones are used to make the tower in the game of Pitthu? 🔢
explanation: Super! Exactly seven flat stones are stacked to make the fun game of Pitthu! 🪨

question: What object is placed at both ends of a Kho-Kho field? 🪵
explanation: Awesome! Two wooden poles are fixed at the ends for players to run around in Kho-Kho! 🪵

question: What is a very important rule about breathing while raiding in Kabaddi? 🫁
explanation: Great job! A raider must hold their breath and keep saying 'Kabaddi' without stopping! 🫁
hint: You cannot take fresh air in.

question: What special physical skill helps you stay up while hopping in Langdi? ⚖️
explanation: Super! Good balance helps you hop on one leg for a long time without falling down in Langdi! ⚖️

question: How do you win the game of Tug of War? 💪
explanation: Awesome! Your team wins by pulling the rope hard to your side using all your strength! 💪

question: What is the best thing to do with our body before starting any running game? 🤸
explanation: Great job! A good warm-up stretches our muscles and makes our body ready to play safely! 🤸

question: Where are traditional games like Kabaddi and Kho-Kho mostly played? 🌳
explanation: Super! These fun games are played outdoors in open grounds or parks to have lots of running space! 🌳

question: What must you do with your raised foot while playing Langdi? 🦶
explanation: Awesome! In Langdi, you must keep your foot up. If it touches the ground, your turn is over! 🦶
hint: Do not let it touch the floor.

question: What do we call a resting spot where players cannot be tagged in some local games? 🏠
explanation: Great job! A safe zone is a special place where runners can rest and cannot be touched! 🏠

question: Who runs away to escape being touched by the chaser in Kho-Kho? 🏃
explanation: Super! The Runners dodge and run around the poles to escape the Chasers in Kho-Kho! 🏃
hint: They move fast to avoid getting caught.

question: What do we call the important person who makes sure game rules are followed? 🧑‍⚖️
explanation: Awesome! The Referee watches the game carefully and makes sure everyone plays fair! 🧑‍⚖️

question: What should you do if your teammate or friend falls down while playing? 🤝
explanation: Great job! True sportsmanship means always helping a friend or opponent if they fall down! 🤝

question: What is another popular Indian name for the game Pitthu? 🪨
explanation: Super! Pitthu is also famously called Lagori in many parts of India! 🪨

question: How many teams play against each other in a game of Kabaddi? 🔢
explanation: Awesome! Kabaddi is an exciting match played between two teams facing each other! 2️⃣

question: What makes traditional Indian games like Langdi and Kho-Kho so accessible and easy to play? ✨
explanation: Great job! Traditional games are amazing because they cost almost nothing and need very little equipment! ✨
hint: You don't need to buy expensive things.

question: Which of these actions is a great way to show team spirit? 👏
explanation: Super! Cheering for your teammates makes them feel happy, strong, and confident! 👏

question: In the game of Gilli Danda, what tool do you use to strike the small Gilli? 🪵
explanation: Awesome! You use the long wooden Danda to hit the Gilli as far as you can! 🪵

question: Why is playing local physical games very good for our bodies? 💪
explanation: Great job! Running and jumping in these games makes our muscles strong and keeps us healthy! 💪

question: Who tries to catch and stop the raider in a game of Kabaddi? 🛡️
explanation: Super! The Defenders work together like a strong chain to safely catch the Raider! 🛡️

question: In Kho-Kho, what shape is the center line connecting the two wooden poles? ➖
explanation: Awesome! A straight center line connects the two poles, and players sit along this line! ➖
hint: It goes straight from one pole to the other.

question: What do players usually hold hands to form in a game like Ringa Ringa Roses? ⭕
explanation: Great job! Players hold hands to make a big, happy round circle while singing the song! ⭕
hint: It is round like a ball.

question: What should you do when you lose a friendly game? 😊
explanation: Super! It is okay to lose sometimes. A good sport smiles, shakes hands, and tries again next time! 😊

question: Which Indian team game is exactly like playing 'Tag' but requires chanting a word constantly? 🤼
explanation: Awesome! Kabaddi is a thrilling game of tag where you must constantly chant 'Kabaddi' on the opponent's side! 🤼
hint: You hold your breath in this game.

question: In Pitthu, what material is the ball usually made of to make sure nobody gets hurt? 🧶
explanation: Great job! We use a soft cloth ball or sponge ball in Pitthu so that players stay safe and happy! 🧶
hint: It is not hard or heavy.

question: What is the best way to get stronger muscles for games like Tug of War? 💪
explanation: Super! Eating healthy food gives your body the strength and energy to pull the rope hard! 🥗

question: Which traditional game requires a lot of dodging, quick turns, and fast running? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! Kho-Kho is an amazing game that tests your speed and ability to dodge quickly! 🏃

question: What is a fun traditional game played with a pebble and numbered boxes drawn on the ground? 🔢
explanation: Great job! In Stapoo, you throw a pebble into a box and hop carefully without touching the lines! 🔢
hint: You hop on one foot through squares.

question: What is the safest thing to wear on your feet to play outdoor running games? 👟
explanation: Super! Sports shoes protect your feet and stop you from slipping while running fast! 👟
hint: They have laces and a good grip.

question: What do polite players do at the end of a friendly game to show respect? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! Shaking hands after a game shows that you respect the other team and enjoyed playing! 🤝

question: What is the most important goal of playing local games with your friends? 😄
explanation: Great job! The most beautiful part of playing games is having fun and making great friends! 😄

question: How does playing outdoor sports regularly help our body and mind? 🌞
explanation: Super! Regular outdoor games keep our mind fresh, our body active, and our heart happy! 🌞

question: What is the team called that runs away to avoid getting hit by the ball in Pitthu? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! The Defending team runs to avoid the ball while bravely trying to rebuild the stones! 🛡️
